figure.note: Curvy hourglass figure throughout in the fitted green wrap dress: full bust, narrow waist, wide hips and full thighs, consistent with the sheet's full-body panels. No visible slimming in any still.

issues.note: Her eyes begin darkening from the light silver-grey of the references (still greyish at 0.3–1.7s and in the 1.12–3.68s eye strip). By 4.6s, 6.0s and 7.4s the irises read hazel/brown.
Eyes are now clearly dark brown (eye strip 8.29–9.06s shows dark brown irises and pupils). This is a defining feature lost, and she reads as a lookalike rather than Priya.
Face looks broader and rounder through the cheeks and jaw at 4.6s and 7.4s, less tapered than the reference oval.
Eye strip shows a dark horizontal band cutting across the visible iris mid-blink. The lid and iris appear blended or ghosted.
Lids stall half-closed at 5.73s and again at 6.24s and 7.01s, with irises partly hidden. These are repeated incomplete or heavy-lidded states rather than quick full blinks.
Lids stay heavy and lowered through 7.27–7.52s; the 7.4s face still also looks heavy-lidded and sleepy.
Gesture is made with her left hand (frame right) at waist height instead of her right hand.
Her left hand is raised toward chest height in a gesture. This is the wrong hand and too high.
Her left hand is again raised near chest level.
Both hands are out and gesturing together in a mirrored open-palm pose.

summary: Figure, camera, scene and outfit hold steady. However, her light silver-grey eyes drift to dark brown from about 3s and are clearly brown by 8.9s, so she no longer reads as Priya. There is also ghosted or half-closed eyelid behaviour around 4.7–7.3s and repeated wrong-hand and both-hand gestures.
